enchantments.tooltip: +2 Enhancement Bonus: +2 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Metalline: Metalline bypasses any metal based damage reduction. (Adamantine, "Alchemical, Silver", Byeshk, Cold Iron, Mithral)
Aligned: Unknown Material: The material for this item is unknown due to the lack of a screenshot or an editor to add it. You can help!
Maiming: This weapon has a twisted haft or grip and spikes along its blade, head, or point. When you score a critical hit with this weapon, it does an additional +2d8 damage.
Freezing 4: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to become frozen to the touch, dealing 4 to 24 Ice damage on each critical hit.
